notes.title: Maps and Spell Animation Optimization
notes.content:
We’ve made some important optimizations to improve your gameplay experience:

[list]
[*] Maps are now built directly into the game instead of loading from the web. This greatly improves loading times and eliminates related connection issues.
[*] Spell animations have also been integrated into the game, ensuring smoother and more reliable performance.
[/list]

Enjoy faster, more seamless gameplay with this update!

notes.title: Update 1.75 (Fogmine Brotherhood)
notes.content:
[h3][b]🛠 What’s New in Hero Quest[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*][b]Force Resistance[/b] now reduces physical damage taken by a percentage, adding more depth to combat strategy.
[*][b]Talent costs for party members[/b] have been significantly reduced, making progression smoother.
[*][b]Stat descriptions[/b] have been improved for better clarity and understanding.
[*][b]Updated UI:[/b] Opponent special traits (like [i]Cautious Behavior[/i] and [i]Initiative[/i]) are now displayed when selecting enemies.
[*][b]New Dungeon:[/b] [color=#FFD700][b]Fogmine[/b][/color] (recommended rating: 700–1400), featuring exciting new gear to collect.
[*][b]New Friendly Camp:[/b] [color=#00FFAA][b]Shivepoint[/b][/color], which offers quests tied to the Fogmine dungeon.
[*][b]Spell Vendor UI[/b] now filters out spells you already know or have in your inventory.
[*][b]Potions[/b] can now be used on [i]disabled units[/i], allowing for better tactical decisions.
[*][b]Mana Potions[/b] have been added to help sustain spellcasting during longer battles.
[*][b]Mortal Strike[/b] now deals an additional [b]8% of the target’s max HP[/b] as bonus damage.
[*][b]Sweeping Strike[/b] no longer splits damage between multiple targets — each target now takes full damage.
[*][b]New Spell: Icy Breath[/b] (Frost Mage) – Deals damage in a 90° cone in the selected direction.
[*][b]New Spell: Holy Nova[/b] (Cleric) – Bursts from the caster, damaging enemies and healing allies in range.
[/list]

[h3][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where purchasing [b]quest items[/b] from the market didn’t complete the quest.
[*][b]Passive spells[/b] can no longer be dragged or repositioned.
[*][b]Frost Nova[/b] now correctly applies a freezing effect in addition to damage.
[*]Fixed a [b]dungeon loading bug[/b] that could lock the game if closed during loading.
[*]Resolved UI issues with [b]item sets[/b].
[*]Fixed a [b]crash[/b] caused by the [b]Revenge[/b] spell under specific conditions.
[*]Fixed a bug where opening the [b]inventory in a friendly town before moving[/b] could freeze the player.
[*]Fixed an issue where [b]spells couldn't be learned[/b] from spell bags.
[*]Corrected [b]hero appearance selection[/b] issues caused by specific class and spell combinations.
[*]Fixed an issue where [b]items couldn’t be swapped[/b] from bags to the backpack.
[*]Fixed a bug allowing [b]non-collectible items[/b] to be added to the [b]collection inventory[/b].
[*]Addressed an issue where the [b]level-up popup[/b] appeared multiple times for the same level.
[*][b]Vitality[/b] is now correctly tracked as one of the [b]Dark Knight's primary stats[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon balancing
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have nerfed encounters in the following areas:

[list]
[*]     [b]Agnar Lake[/b]
[*]     [b]Icewind Norg Camp[/b]
[*]     [b]Barkskin Norg Camp[/b]
[*]     [b]Alaric's Tomb[/b]
[*]     [b]Reclusa's Lair[/b]
[*]     [b]Mistfields[/b]
[/list]
Some of these encounters were overly difficult, and these adjustments should provide a more balanced experience. Thank you for your feedback, and we’ll continue to monitor gameplay balance!

Best regards,
Future Intellect
